nodes.label: ESLint Project Linter Configuration
nodes.rationale: Standardizes code quality rules across modern React and TypeScript files, using flat config structure.

nodes.label: Application TypeScript Configuration
nodes.rationale: Optimizes bundle settings for browser environments, enforcing strict typechecking rules on src files.

nodes.label: Vite Node Environment TypeScript Configuration
nodes.rationale: Isolates node execution types and target compiler settings for the Vite build system configuration.

nodes.label: Vite Bundler Configuration
nodes.rationale: Integrates @vitejs/plugin-react for fast refresh compilation during local development.

nodes.label: Application Bootstrapping Entry Point
nodes.rationale: Initializes React's StrictMode and mounts the core App component onto the root DOM element.

nodes.label: App Root Shell and Router Component
nodes.rationale: Establishes React Router v7 routes mapping client cockpits (Admin, Customer, POS Seller) under their respective layouts.
nodes.norm_label: app root shell and router component

nodes.label: Modal Shared Dialog Component
nodes.rationale: Encapsulates backdrop blur animation and handles focus, close buttons, and prevents background scrolling when overlay is active.

nodes.label: Toast Alert Center Container
nodes.rationale: Subscribes to AuthContext notifications list and displays stackable, color-coded reactive alert prompts.

nodes.label: Toast Alert Item
nodes.rationale: Renders alert icons and border accents depending on message types (success, info, warning, danger).

nodes.label: Authentication State Provider
nodes.rationale: Centralizes session storage bootstrap, authentication states, global Toast dispatch events, and Mock database bypass switches.

nodes.label: Auth State Consumer Hook
nodes.rationale: Exposes a custom hook ensuring safe consumption of session contexts inside layout and page widgets.

nodes.label: Admin Cockpit Shell Layout
nodes.rationale: Implements the side panel navigation, mobile responsiveness toggle, top header controls, and verifies admin credentials.

nodes.label: Customer Portal Shell Layout
nodes.rationale: Provides a top-navbar portal design, links Ledger and Redemptions catalogs, and gates access to customers.

nodes.label: POS Merchant Terminal Shell Layout
nodes.rationale: Draws the cashier counter interface layout, connects historic receipt trails, and handles POS seller logins.

nodes.label: Role Verification Gate Check
nodes.rationale: Decoupled authentication safeguard design that intercepts unauthorized client sessions inside layout structures and navigates back to the Login screen with query params.

nodes.label: Dynamic Login Page
nodes.rationale: Switches themes, titles, and styles reactively depending on the targeted persona role parameter.

nodes.label: Rapid Developer Testing Credentials Prefill
nodes.rationale: Enables instant forms autofill based on the role parameters to facilitate faster development workflows and user testing.

nodes.label: Unified Cockpits Hub Selection Page
nodes.rationale: Displays modern neon glowing dashboard selector card widgets for Admin, Customer, and Seller access entries.

nodes.label: Mock DB Bypass and Server Selector Switch
nodes.rationale: Provides visual toggle controls to alternate between static Mock DB testing environments and a live backend Server environment.
nodes.norm_label: mock db bypass and server selector switch

nodes.label: Admin Campaigns Catalog Table View
nodes.rationale: Renders point costs, claimed statistics progress bars, stock indicator alerts, and handles fetch hooks.

nodes.label: Create Campaign Wizard Modal Form
nodes.rationale: Manages input state for point cost validation and transforms comma-separated strings into a coupon array pool.

nodes.label: Mock Fallback Design Pattern
nodes.rationale: Ensures offline capability and rapid frontend development in the absence of a running backend by dynamically falling back to client-side localStorage state upon failure.

nodes.label: Tier Ladder System Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Determines membership tier upgrades (Bronze, Silver, Gold) dynamically using point balance thresholds to incentivize customer transactions.

nodes.label: Earning Rules Multiplier Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Calculates point deposits by evaluating active rules including spent-dollar ratios and product-SKU specific bonuses during cashier receipt uploads.
